ladder.title: How violations are handled
ladder.s2: Second violation: a warning and a write pause of {hours} hours.
ladder.s3: Third violation: a suspension of {days} days.
ladder.s4: After that a platform admin looks at the case.
ladder.expiry: Violations expire after {months} months. The jury only decides whether there was a violation. The consequence follows from the step.
ladder.appeal: You can appeal once. Then a different jury decides.

mine.emergencyNote: Emergency report: the content was hidden until it was reviewed.
mine.appealHint: Once, in the first {days} days. A different jury decides.

admin.queueNone: Nothing waits for a second admin.
admin.queueMine: Proposed by you. A second admin has to agree.
admin.kind_unblock_initiative: Lift the block on an initiative
admin.pending: Waiting for a second admin to agree.
admin.only_one: There is only one admin. Appoint a second person so that rights and blocks are decided by two people.
admin.emergencyText: The content stays hidden until you decide.
admin.reason: Reason (at least 10 characters, the person concerned sees it)
admin.disclosuresText: Data goes to authorities only on a court order. Every case is noted here without names and appears in the transparency report.

transparency.title: Transparency report
transparency.lead: Numbers about moderation and administration of this platform, without names. It appears once a year and is calculated from the data as it stands.
transparency.how: How a report works: confirmation with a case number, review by a jury drawn by lot from the region (at once by the platform when there is danger), reasons for the person concerned, an appeal to a different jury. Reports and decisions are kept for {months} months.
transparency.logText: Every action of the platform admins, without names.
transparency.operator: The operator's contact is in the legal notice.
